paragraphs.text: The Svyelunite Temple was a holy place dedicated to worshipping the goddess Svyelun . Its ruins are located in the Old Voda Sea , off the continent of Sarpadia on the plane of Dominaria .

By the time of the fall of Vodalia , the worship of Svyelun had already abated, and her name started to fade into myth. With the coming of the homarid civilization due to the cooling climate, the temple was abandoned by the merfolk and slowly fell into ruin.
